articles.title: How Computers That Learn From Old Storms Are Helping Forecasters
articles.summary: An AI model correctly predicted Hurricane Isaias's path in early October, but human forecasters still blend models and explain the risks.

articles.title: A Court Ruling, but Families Are Still Waiting for Visas
articles.summary: A judge ordered a visa ban lifted in August, but families like the Hoffmans are still waiting, lawyers say, as extra checks continue.

articles.title: Opening More Forest Land May Not Fix Loggers' Biggest Problems
articles.summary: Loggers say fuel costs, worker shortages and a shrunken industry matter more than opening roadless forests, even as a repeal is expected early next year.
